description: Tell PaidRouter which routes the owner uses (e.g. stripe_card, paypal_checkout, venmo_business, or a corridor like USD->MXN). From then on, any PaidRouter answer to this key starts with 'Since your last call, routes you watch changed: ...' when a fee or the best FX provider moved. Optionally give an https webhook_url: when the daily check finds a change on a watched route, PaidRouter POSTs {event: 'fee_changes', changes: [...]} to it, signed with HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using your PaidRouter key as the secret, hex in the x-paidrouter-signature header (sha256=...). Each call replaces the list; send an empty list to stop watching. Up to 50 routes.

webhook_url.description: https URL to POST changes to (optional)

name: watch_routes
title: Watch routes
